Title text '2024 in detail: a staircase in April, an outage in June, the staircase repeated in July'

g.text: 2024 in detail: a staircase in April, an outage in June, the staircase repeated in July

text.aria-label: Title text 'Site E was energised in stages, and kept rising after the network scheme went live'

g.text: Site E was energised in stages, and kept rising after the network scheme went live

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each point is one day's median ratio of site E's capacity factor to the median capacity factor of the five other solar farms, over half-hours when the fleet was generating well. Half-hours the export cap had moved, once the scheme was live, are excluded. Orange bars are fitted constant levels. Site E has no telemetry between 9 February and 11 March 2024, so the record starts in mid-March.'
text.tspan: Each point is one day's median ratio of site E's capacity factor to the median capacity factor of the five other
solar farms, over half-hours when the fleet was generating well. Half-hours the export cap had moved, once the
scheme was live, are excluded. Orange bars are fitted constant levels. Site E has no telemetry between
9 February and 11 March 2024, so the record starts in mid-March.
